summaries.name: Cabomba
summaries.summary: Cabomba (Cabomba caroliniana) is an easy-to-care-for aquarium plant that grows quickly, providing a nice background or mid-water decoration, and prefers moderate to high lighting.

summaries.name: Anubias
summaries.summary: Anubias (Anubias spp.) plants are low-maintenance aquarium plants that can thrive in low to moderate lighting conditions and are great for creating a natural-looking aquarium.

summaries.name: guppies
summaries.summary: Guppies are kept, along with some plants, in a small 1-gallon tank the user set up for a friend's kid.
